items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Aunt Bessie was pretty good friend, you know.

ctx.x: Now, she remembers too, but she's right there.
That's right. Aunt Bessie was pretty good friend, you know. Yeah. And she was a chorus girl.

Did Bessie seem in pretty good health? I never did know Bessie Smith except to see her on the stage. Oh, yeah, she was a good one. She seemed in still good health. She was. When I last saw her, she looked good, you know. She was always pretty heavy, but it seemed... She was in pretty good health. Good health and spirits as far as I could tell. That's right. She wasn't really so old either. No. I think, you know, maybe around 40 or something. That's right.

items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: that's the same show that Bessie Smith was on... Bessie met us on the, she came to the show... I and her husband were there together

ctx.x: Well, now, the last show, the last minstrel show I was with was, I think that was in 1937. When I was with Brobby Rastus, that's the same show that Bessie Smith was on.
